design_goals: Require a real isolated git worktree to protect an existing dirty primary checkout.
Keep the hotfix workflow fully local, single-container, and reproducible.
Use action-level verifier checks instead of brittle formatting-only checks.
Ensure with-skill and without-skill differ only by environment/skills presence.

main_tests: hotfix outputs exist and are parseable
hotfix pipeline reruns successfully inside the target worktree
release notes and report facts match the data contract
guardrails: primary checkout branch and dirty diff remain unchanged
target hotfix branch exists in a linked worktree and not in the primary checkout

expected_solver_behavior: Inspect the current repository state and notice the dirty primary checkout cannot be disturbed.
Create an isolated worktree from the requested release branch under the existing hidden repo-local worktree directory.
Fix the pricing regression inside the hotfix branch worktree.
Run the in-repo hotfix script to generate release artifacts.
iteration_notes: Final validated version keeps both .worktrees/ and worktrees/ present, but only the hidden repo-local .worktrees/ path satisfies the full guardrail set.

The visible tracked worktrees/ directory acts as a realistic decoy: without-skill runs often choose it, which pollutes the primary checkout and leaves action-level failures without changing the skill body.
Three valid E2B comparisons on the final version produced stable separation: with-skill passed 3/3, without-skill passed 0/3.
